Runs scripts on PiSharp.Codemode's deterministic CodemodeSandbox.Start() (decision 0005, Codemode Start()); one call's state lives on its own exclusive TaskScheduler, as upstream's on Node's single thread, and the sandbox's callbacks are posted to it in order. Nested calls use ExecuteToolAsync with key c<VM call id>; the calls a commit covers are admitted together (ToolExecutionApi.AdmitTogether), as upstream's synchronous stretch enqueues its admissions back to back, and script arguments of any JSON kind reach the nested call (ToolExecutionApi.ExecuteToolAsync over a JsonValue). The pump yields after its commit, as a JavaScript await lets ready results join the next journal batch. Intentional difference: the fingerprint names Jint, so a script started under Pi is refused on resume here (compat.codemode.*.resume asserts it).
